extraction.method: pdftotext -layout from the PDF text layer, then whitespace cleanup and removal of page-number lines (kept per phase in raw_text). Structured rows were split from raw_text by script and checked against the page images. Arabic passages were retyped by hand from the page images (rendered at 300-500 dpi).
extraction.verify_by: A guru of each subject reviews the rows (D-037); a reader of Arabic checks the retyped passages against PDF pages 99-101.
conventions: raw_text is the original extraction, unchanged, kept for traceability. It still has the broken Arabic; never import Arabic from it.

Each phase has lead_in (the 'Pada akhir fase ...' sentence), optional element_intros (a sentence printed under an element heading before its first sub-element), and outcomes[] {element, sub_element, text}.

outcomes[].text is the printed text with line breaks joined: a line ending in '-' or '/' joins without a space (all such breaks in these pages are real hyphens or slashes). Bullets are dropped. Capitalisation and punctuation are as printed. Source errors are corrected (D-115, see source_corrections); raw_text keeps them as printed.

sub_element is null when the source prints no sub-heading (SKI Pemahaman Konsep, both Bahasa Arab elements). Sub-element names are normalised: straight apostrophe in Al-Qur'an, and 'Mengomunikasikanhasil' (SKI Fase B) written as 'Mengomunikasikan hasil'. Names are otherwise as printed, so wording differs between phases (e.g. 'Mengevaluasi dan refleksi' vs 'Mengevaluasi dan merefleksi').
subjects[].elements[].sub_elements lists every sub-element name used in any phase, in order of first appearance.

Arabic passages (Bahasa Arab only; the other subjects have no Arabic script) appear inline in outcomes[].text where the source prints them, and again in outcomes[].arabic_passages[] {pdf_page, text}. They are Unicode with full harakat in logical order (renders right to left). Arabic question mark '؟' and comma '،' are as printed; the source uses the Latin semicolon ';' between patterns, kept as '; '. Spaces before ';' and between '...' and the word before it are dropped.

extraction.arabic_check: Letter counts (harakat ignored) of each retyped phase equal those of the text layer, except letters the text layer drops inside ligatures: the madda alif in الْآنَ (Fase B, C), meem after lam in الْمَدْرَسَةِ/الْمُذَاكَرَةِ (Fase C, 4x), and hamza alif in بِالْأُذُنِ (Fase C). Mengidentifikasi dan menerapkan adab belajar, mandi, berpakaian, bersin, menguap, makan, dan minum.
